sanskrit: tataḥ sumantras tv āgamya rāghavaṃ vākyam abravīt ete nivāritā rājan dvāri tiṣṭhanti tāpasāḥ
english: Then Sumantra, having come, said to Rāghava: "These ascetics, O king, have been stopped and stand at the gate."

sanskrit: bhārgavaṃ cyavanaṃ nāma puraskṛtya maharṣayaḥ darśanaṃ te mahārāja codayanti kṛtatvarāḥ prīyamāṇā naravyāghra yamunātīravāsinaḥ
english: "The great seers, placing the Bhārgava named Cyavana at their head, are urgently requesting an audience with you, O great king — they are eager and pleased, O tiger among men, they who dwell on the banks of the Yamunā."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rāmaḥ provāca dharmavit praveśyantāṃ mahātmāno bhārgavapramukhā dvijāḥ
english: Hearing those words of his, Rāma, the knower of dharma, said: "Let those great-souled twice-born ones, with the Bhārgava at their head, be admitted."

sanskrit: rājñas tv ājñāṃ puraskṛtya dvāḥstho mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ praveśayām āsa tatas tāpasān saṃmatān bahūn
english: The doorkeeper, honouring the king's command, with joined palms raised to his head, then admitted the many revered ascetics.

sanskrit: śataṃ samadhikaṃ tatra dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā praviṣṭaṃ rājabhavanaṃ tāpasānāṃ mahātmanām
english: More than a hundred of those great-souled ascetics, blazing with their own inner radiance, then entered the royal palace.

sanskrit: te dvijāḥ pūrṇakalaśaiḥ sarvatīrthāmbu satkṛtam gṛhītvā phalamūlaṃ ca rāmasyābhyāharan bahu
english: Those twice-born ones brought in abundance to Rāma full water-pots honoured with water from all sacred fords, and also fruits and roots.

sanskrit: pratigṛhya tu tat sarvaṃ rāmaḥ prītipuraskṛtaḥ tīrthodakāni sarvāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca
english: Rāma, filled with affection, received all of it — all the sacred-ford waters and the various fruits.

sanskrit: uvāca ca mahābāhuḥ sarvān eva mahāmunīn imāny āsanamukhyāni yathārham upaviśyatām
english: And the mighty-armed one addressed all those great sages: "Pray be seated, each according to his rank, on these finest of seats."

sanskrit: rāmasya bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā sarva eva maharṣayaḥ bṛsīṣu rucirākhyāsu niṣeduḥ kāñcanīṣu te
english: Hearing Rāma's words, all those great seers sat down on the beautiful golden cushioned seats.

sanskrit: upaviṣṭān ṛṣīṃs tatra dṛṣṭvā parapuraṃjayaḥ prayataḥ prāñjalir bhūtvā rāghavo vākyam abravīt
english: Seeing the seers seated there, the conqueror of enemy cities, Rāghava, with a pure heart and joined palms, spoke these words.

sanskrit: kim āgamanakāryaṃ vaḥ kiṃ karomi tapodhanāḥ ājñāpyo 'haṃ maharṣīṇāṃ sarvakāmakaraḥ sukham
english: "What is the purpose of your coming? What may I do for you, O wealth-of-austerity ones? I am at the command of the great seers, the glad fulfiller of every wish."

sanskrit: idaṃ rājyaṃ ca sakalaṃ jīvitaṃ ca hṛdi sthitam sarvam etad dvijārthaṃ me satyam etad bravīmi vaḥ
english: "This entire kingdom and the life dear to my heart — all of this is for the sake of the twice-born. I speak this truth to you."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sādhuvādo mahān abhūt ṛṣīṇām ugratapasāṃ yamunātīravāsinām
english: Hearing his words, there arose a great cry of "well said!" from those fierce-austerity seers dwelling on the bank of the Yamunā.

sanskrit: ūcuś ca te mahātmāno harṣeṇa mahatānvitāḥ upapannaṃ naraśreṣṭha tavaiva bhuvi nānyataḥ
english: And those great-souled ones, filled with great joy, said: "This is fitting for you alone in this world, O best of men, and no other."

sanskrit: bahavaḥ pārthivā rājann atikrāntā mahābalāḥ kāryagauravam aśrutvā pratijñāṃ nābhyarocayan
english: "Many mighty kings have passed away, O king, who, not heeding the gravity of duty, did not deign to make such a pledge."

sanskrit: tvayā punar brāhmaṇagauravād iyaṃ kṛtā pratijñā hy anavekṣya kāraṇam kuruṣva kartā hy asi nātra saṃśayo mahābhayāt trātum ṛṣīṃs tvam arhasi
english: "But you, out of reverence for the brāhmaṇas, have made this pledge without looking for reasons — now fulfil it. You are capable of it, there is no doubt. You ought to protect the seers from this great terror."

sanskrit: bruvadbhir evam ṛṣibhiḥ kākutstho vākyam abravīt kiṃ kāryaṃ brūta bhavatāṃ bhayaṃ nāśayitāsmi vaḥ
english: While the seers were speaking thus, Kākutstha said: "Tell me what the task is. I shall destroy the fear that afflicts you."

sanskrit: tathā vadati kākutsthe bhārgavo vākyam abravīt bhayaṃ naḥ śṛṇu yan mūlaṃ deśasya ca nareśvara
english: As Kākutstha spoke thus, the Bhārgava said: "Hear, O lord of men, the root-cause of our fear and of this land's fear."

sanskrit: pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge rāma daiteyaḥ sumahābalaḥ lolāputro 'bhavaj jyeṣṭho madhur nāma mahāsuraḥ
english: "In former times, in the Kṛta age, O Rāma, there was a Daiteya of immense power, the eldest son of Lolā, a great asura named Madhu."

sanskrit: brahmaṇyaś ca śaraṇyaś ca buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitaḥ suraiś ca paramodāraiḥ prītis tasyātulābhavat
english: "He was devoted to the brāhmaṇas, a provider of refuge, accomplished in wisdom, and the most supremely noble gods held incomparable affection for him."

sanskrit: sa madhur vīryasaṃpanno dharme ca susamāhitaḥ bahumānāc ca rudreṇa dattas tasyādbhuto varaḥ
english: "That Madhu, endowed with valour and deeply established in dharma, was given by Rudra, out of great esteem, a wondrous boon."

sanskrit: śūlaṃ śūlād viniṣkṛṣya mahāvīryaṃ mahāprabham dadau mahātmā suprīto vākyaṃ caitad uvāca ha
english: "The great-souled one, greatly pleased, drew from his own trident the mighty, exceedingly radiant spear and gave it, and spoke these words:"

sanskrit: tvayāyam atulo dharmo matprasādāt kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ prītyā paramayā yukto dadāmy āyudham uttamam
english: "'This matchless and auspicious dharma has been practised by you through my grace. Filled with supreme affection, I give you this supreme weapon.'"

sanskrit: yāvat suraiś ca vipraiś ca na virudhyer mahāsura tāvac chūlaṃ tavedaṃ syād anyathā nāśam āpnuyāt
english: "'So long as you do not quarrel with the gods or the brāhmaṇas, O great asura, this trident shall be yours; otherwise it will be destroyed.'"

sanskrit: yaś ca tvām abhiyuñjīta yuddhāya vigatajvaraḥ taṃ śūlaṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā punar eṣyati te karam
english: "'Whoever challenges you to battle without fear — the trident, having reduced him to ashes, will return to your hand.'"

sanskrit: evaṃ rudrād varaṃ labdhvā bhūya eva mahāsuraḥ praṇipatya mahādevaṃ vākyam etad uvāca ha
english: "Having thus received the boon from Rudra, the great asura again prostrated before Mahādeva and spoke these words:"

sanskrit: bhagavan mama vaṃśasya śūlam etad anuttamam bhavet tu satataṃ deva surāṇām īśvaro hy asi
english: "'O Blessed One, may this supreme trident remain perpetually in my lineage, O god — for you are the lord of the gods.'"

sanskrit: taṃ bruvāṇaṃ madhuṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtapatiḥ śivaḥ pratyuvāca mahādevo naitad evaṃ bhaviṣyati
english: "To Madhu speaking thus, the god, Śiva, lord of all beings, Mahādeva, replied: 'It shall not be so in this manner.'"

sanskrit: mā bhūt te viphalā vāṇī matprasādakṛtā śubhā bhavataḥ putram ekaṃ tu śūlam etad gamiṣyati
english: "'Let not your auspicious words, made by my grace, be fruitless. This trident shall pass to one son of yours.'"

sanskrit: yāvat karasthaḥ śūlo 'yaṃ bhaviṣyati sutasya te avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śūlahasto bhaviṣyati
english: "'As long as this trident remains in the hand of your son, he shall be invincible by all beings, the trident-bearer.'"

sanskrit: evaṃ madhur varaṃ labdhvā devāt sumahad adbhutam bhavanaṃ cāsuraśreṣṭhaḥ kārayām āsa suprabham
english: "Thus Madhu, having received from the god this most wondrous great boon, the foremost among asuras had a splendid abode built."

sanskrit: tasya patnī mahābhāgā priyā kumbhīnasī hi yā viśvāvasor apatyaṃ sā hy analāyāṃ mahāprabhā
english: "His beloved wife, the highly fortunate Kumbhīnasī, was the offspring of Viśvāvasu, born of Analā, of great radiance."

sanskrit: tasyāḥ putro mahāvīryo lavaṇo nāma dāruṇaḥ bālyāt prabhṛti duṣṭātmā pāpāny eva samācarat
english: "Her son, of great valour, named Lavaṇa, was ferocious; from childhood his soul was wicked and he committed only evil deeds."

sanskrit: taṃ putraṃ durvinītaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā duḥkhasamanvitaḥ madhuḥ sa śokam āpede na cainaṃ kiṃ cid abravīt
english: "Seeing that undisciplined son, Madhu was filled with grief and fell into sorrow, yet he said nothing to him."

sanskrit: sa vihāya imaṃ lokaṃ praviṣṭo varuṇālayam śūlaṃ niveśya lavaṇe varaṃ tasmai nyavedayat
english: "He, leaving this world, entered the abode of Varuṇa; having placed the trident in Lavaṇa's care, he conveyed to him the boon."

sanskrit: sa prabhāvena śūlasya daurātmyenātmanas tathā saṃtāpayati lokāṃs trīn viśeṣeṇa tu tāpasān
english: "He, by the power of the trident and likewise by the wickedness of his own nature, torments the three worlds, and the ascetics in particular."

sanskrit: evaṃprabhāvo lavaṇaḥ śūlaṃ caiva tathāvidham śrutvā pramāṇaṃ kākutstha tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ
english: "Such is the might of Lavaṇa, and such is the nature of that trident — knowing this authority, O Kākutstha, you are our highest refuge."

sanskrit: bahavaḥ pārthivā rāma bhayārtair ṛṣibhiḥ purā abhayaṃ yācitā vīra trātāraṃ na ca vidmahe
english: "Many kings, O Rāma, were in former times beseeched by fear-stricken seers for refuge, O hero, yet we found no protector."

sanskrit: te vayaṃ rāvaṇaṃ śrutvā hataṃ sabalavāhanam trātāraṃ vidmahe rāma nānyaṃ bhuvi narādhipam tat paritrātum icchāmo lavaṇād bhayapīḍitāḥ
english: "We, having heard that Rāvaṇa together with his forces and army has been slain, acknowledge you, O Rāma, as our protector and no other king on earth. Thus we, tormented by fear, desire to be rescued from Lavaṇa."

sanskrit: tathokte tān ṛṣīn rāmaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ kimāhāraḥ kimācāro lavaṇaḥ kva ca vartate
english: When they had spoken thus, Rāma, with joined palms, replied to those seers: "What does Lavaṇa eat? What are his habits? And where does he dwell?"

sanskrit: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te tato nivedayām āsur lavaṇo vavṛdhe yathā
english: Hearing Rāghava's words, all those seers then reported to him how Lavaṇa had grown powerful.

sanskrit: āhāraḥ sarvasattvāni viśeṣeṇa ca tāpasāḥ ācāro raudratā nityaṃ vāso madhuvane sadā
english: "His food is all living creatures, the ascetics in particular. His conduct is perpetual ferocity. His abode is always in the Madhuvana forest."

sanskrit: hatvā daśasahasrāṇi siṃhavyāghramṛgadvipān mānuṣāṃś caiva kurute nityam āhāram āhnikam
english: "Slaying ten thousand lions, tigers, deer, and elephants, as well as human beings, he makes his daily meal each day."

sanskrit: tato 'parāṇi sattvāni khādate sa mahābalaḥ saṃhāre samanuprāpte vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ
english: "Then that mighty one devours still other creatures — like Death at the time of universal dissolution, with gaping mouth."

sanskrit: tac chrutvā rāghavo vākyam uvāca sa mahāmunīn ghātayiṣyāmi tad rakṣo vyapagacchatu vo bhayam
english: Hearing that account, Rāghava said to those great sages: "I shall slay that rākṣasa. Let your fear depart."

sanskrit: tathā teṣāṃ pratijñāya munīnām ugratejasām sa bhrātṝn sahitān sarvān uvāca raghunandanaḥ
english: Having thus given his pledge to those fierce-lustred sages, the joy of the Raghu-line then addressed all his brothers assembled together.

sanskrit: ko hantā lavaṇaṃ vīrāḥ kasyāṃśaḥ sa vidhīyatām bharatasya mahābāhoḥ śatrughnasyātha vā punaḥ
english: "Who among you heroes shall be the slayer of Lavaṇa? To whom shall that assignment be given — to the mighty-armed Bharata, or again to Śatrughna?"

sanskrit: rāghaveṇaivam uktas tu bharato vākyam abravīt aham enaṃ vadhiṣyāmi mamāṃśaḥ sa vidhīyatām
english: Thus addressed by Rāghava, Bharata spoke: "I shall slay him. Let that assignment be given to me."

sanskrit: bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā śauryavīryasamanvitam lakṣmaṇāvarajas tasthau hitvā sauvarṇam āsanam
english: Hearing the words of Bharata, full of courage and valour, the younger brother of Lakṣmaṇa — Śatrughna — rose from his golden seat.

sanskrit: śatrughnas tv abravīd vākyaṃ praṇipatya narādhipam kṛtakarmā mahābāhur madhyamo raghunandanaḥ
english: And Śatrughna, prostrating before the king, spoke — the mighty-armed middle son among the Raghu-joys who had already accomplished great deeds:

sanskrit: āryeṇa hi purā śūnyā ayodhyā rakṣitā purī saṃtāpaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā āryasyāgamanaṃ prati
english: "Indeed, in former times the noble one guarded the empty city of Ayodhyā, bearing anguish in his heart in anticipation of the noble one's return."

sanskrit: duḥkhāni ca bahūnīha anubhūtāni pārthiva śayāno duḥkhaśayyāsu nandigrāme mahātmanā
english: "And many sorrows have been endured here, O king — the great-souled one lying on beds of sorrow in Nandigrāma."

sanskrit: phalamūlāśano bhūtvā jaṭācīradharas tathā anubhūyedṛśaṃ duḥkham eṣa rāghavanandanaḥ preṣye mayi sthite rājan na bhūyaḥ kleśam āpnuyāt
english: "Subsisting on fruit and roots, wearing matted locks and bark garments, this son of Raghu endured such suffering. With me, your servant, now present, O king, he should not suffer any more hardship."

sanskrit: tathā bruvati śatrughne rāghavaḥ punar abravīt evaṃ bhavatu kākutstha kriyatāṃ mama śāsanam
english: As Śatrughna spoke thus, Rāghava replied again: "So be it, O Kākutstha — let my command be carried out."

sanskrit: rājye tvām abhiṣekṣyāmi madhos tu nagare śubhe niveśaya mahābāho bharataṃ yady avekṣase
english: "I shall consecrate you as king in the beautiful city of Madhu; establish Bharata there, O mighty-armed one, if you regard my word."

sanskrit: śūras tvaṃ kṛtavidyaś ca samarthaḥ saṃniveśane nagaraṃ madhunā juṣṭaṃ tathā janapadāñ śubhān
english: "You are a hero, accomplished in learning, and capable of establishing that city frequented by Madhu, as well as the fair provinces."

sanskrit: yo hi vaṃśaṃ samutpāṭya pārthivasya punaḥ kṣaye na vidhatte nṛpaṃ tatra narakaṃ sa nigacchati
english: "For he who uproots a royal lineage and at its extinction does not install a king there — that man goes to hell."

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ hatvā madhusutaṃ lavaṇaṃ pāpaniścayam rājyaṃ praśādhi dharmeṇa vākyaṃ me yady avekṣase
english: "Therefore you, having slain Lavaṇa, the son of Madhu, that one of evil resolve, rule the kingdom by dharma — if you regard my word."

sanskrit: uttaraṃ ca na vaktavyaṃ śūra vākyāntare mama bālena pūrvajasyājñā kartavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: "And do not speak in return, O hero, interrupting my words. The command of an elder brother must be carried out by a younger — there is no doubt in this matter."

sanskrit: abhiṣekaṃ ca kākutstha pratīcchasva mayodyatam vasiṣṭhapramukhair viprair vidhimantrapuraskṛtam
english: "And accept, O Kākutstha, the consecration prepared by me, preceded by rites and mantras performed by Vasiṣṭha and the other brāhmaṇas."
